main.year_aliya: chart-yearly, chart-heat, chart-regions, chart-cyears, chart-profile, chart-districts, kpi:total, kpi:last, kpi:change, kpi:peak, insight:trend, insight:peak, insight:region_shift — year of aliyah; one file per year, dedup guard if a year appears in two files
main.month_aliya: chart-heat, insight:season, kpi:change — month of aliyah; detects a partial latest year (last month before December)
main.age: chart-pyramid, chart-profile, chart-agec, kpi:median_age, insight:age, insight:women — age on the day of aliyah, binned by 5 years
main.age_tday: skip: age at the file's export date; drifts with every export and is named differently per file, so age at aliyah is used instead
main.erez_moza: chart-countries, chart-cyears, chart-agec, kpi:countries, insight:leader, insight:peak, insight:age — country of origin
main.subcont: chart-regions, insight:region_shift — sub-continent of origin; top 6 + אחר
main.yeshuv_klita: chart-cities, kpi:cities, insight:cities — settlement of first residence; top 15
main.machoz: chart-districts — ministry district; names that start or stop mid-series are listed in the chart note
main.mikzoa: chart-occ, chart-prof — declared occupation; non-occupational codes (pupils, students, pensioners, homemakers, unspecified) grouped, top 15 occupations among the rest
heb.שנת עלייה: chart-yearly, chart-heat, chart-regions, chart-cyears, chart-profile, chart-districts, kpi:total, kpi:last, kpi:change, kpi:peak — Hebrew-header twin of year_aliya (the 2024 file)
heb.חודש עלייה: chart-heat, insight:season, kpi:change — twin of month_aliya
heb.גיל ביום העלייה: chart-pyramid, chart-profile, chart-agec, kpi:median_age, insight:age — twin of age
heb.גיל ב- 1/12/2025: skip: age at an export date (twin of age_tday); the column name itself carries the date
heb.מגדר: chart-pyramid, chart-profile, kpi:women, insight:women — twin of gender
heb.ארץ מוצא: chart-countries, chart-cyears, chart-agec, kpi:countries, insight:leader — twin of erez_moza
heb.ישוב: chart-cities, kpi:cities, insight:cities — twin of yeshuv_klita
